headline: This patch provides significant buffs to several fighters and mages while adjusting the efficiency of sustain and jungle clearing.

entities.reason: Q base damage increased by 15 across all ranks (e.g., 60 ⇒ 75 at rank 1).
entities.impact: Increases his early to mid-game poke and waveclear damage output.

entities.reason: Health growth decreased from 110 to 105 and R attack speed scaling adjusted (e.g., 25% ⇒ 20% at rank 3).
entities.impact: Reduces her overall survivability and late-game DPS in her True Form.

entities.reason: Buffs to mana (339 ⇒ 375), W cooldown (15s ⇒ 12s), and W outer cone damage (6% ⇒ 7% base).
entities.impact: Improves her laning sustain and burst potential through more frequent and harder-hitting W casts.

entities.reason: Passive healing increased from 50% to 67% post-mitigation and AP scaling increased from 6.5% to 7%.
entities.impact: Significantly increases her survival and dueling capability in extended fights.

entities.reason: R bonus resistances increased (20/40/60 ⇒ 25/50/75) and R damage/scaling increased (110 + 22.5% AP ⇒ 120 + 25% AP).
entities.impact: Increases his team fight impact by making his ultimate more lethal and harder to punish.

entities.reason: Q stack gain on champions/large targets adjusted from 3 (up to 12) to 4 (up to 10).
entities.impact: Faster early stacking but a lower ceiling for single-hit stack gains; neutralizes overall power.

entities.reason: Buffs to mana, W resistances (12% ⇒ 16%), and Q monster cap, despite a nerf to base AD and Q bonus AD scaling.
entities.impact: Shifts her toward a more durable tank role with better jungle clearing, though her early burst is slightly lower.

entities.reason: Attack speed increased from 25% to 30% (T3 40% ⇒ 45%).
entities.impact: Increases the DPS of all attack-speed reliant champions, especially in the early game.

entities.reason: Attack damage increased from 40 to 45.
entities.impact: Slightly increases the burst and sustained damage of fighters who build it.

entities.reason: Damage increased (6% Melee ⇒ 8% Melee) while shield base value slightly decreased (160 ⇒ 150 Melee).
entities.impact: Increases damage output against tanks while slightly reducing burst survivability.

entities.reason: Move speed increased (4% ⇒ 5%) and bolt damage increased (55% ⇒ 65% AD).
entities.impact: Increases the late-game team fight damage and kiting ability of marksmen.

entities.reason: Bonus AD increased from 45% to 50% of base AD.
entities.impact: Increases the damage output of bruisers during their shield window.

entities.reason: Health increased (400 ⇒ 450) and recipe simplified, but healing reduced (6% ⇒ 4% missing health).
entities.impact: Trades some sustain for more raw durability and a faster build path.

entities.reason: Damage scaling increased (1% ⇒ 1.5% bonus HP) but cost increased (600g ⇒ 700g) and minion/monster damage reduced.
entities.impact: Stronger against champions in fights, but slower to build and weaker for waveclear.

entities.reason: Magic Resistance decreased from 30 to 25.
entities.impact: Reduces the overall tankiness of users against magic damage.

entities.reason: Flat magic penetration increased from 18 to 20.
entities.impact: Increases early game magic damage penetration for mages.

entities.reason: Attack damage increased from 20 to 25.
entities.impact: Slightly improves early jungle clear and trading for melee champions.

entities.reason: Base healing increased from 10-130 to 15-160.
entities.impact: Improves laning sustain for both melee and ranged champions.

entities.reason: Melee attack speed nerfed (120% ⇒ 90%) but bonus AD scaling increased (8% ⇒ 12%).
entities.impact: Shifts the rune from raw speed to higher scaling damage per hit.

entities.reason: Base MR adjusted from 30 + 1.3/level to 33 + 1.1/level.
entities.impact: Increases early game survivability against mages but reduces late game MR growth.

entities.reason: Base MR adjusted from 28 + 1.3/level to 33 + 1.1/level.
entities.impact: Similar to general ADCs, she is slightly tankier early but softer late.

entities.reason: Increased scaling for AP (12% ⇒ 16%), Armor (20% ⇒ 25%), MR (20% ⇒ 25%), and Health (3% ⇒ 4%).
entities.impact: Speeds up jungle clearing for all junglers, especially those with AP or tank builds.

entities.reason: Increased gold/exp penalty outside bot lane (-25% ⇒ -33%) and extended penalty duration (level 3 ⇒ level 5).
entities.impact: Strongly discourages supports from roaming or farming in other lanes early game.
